definitions.gloss: to assign, to allocate, to allot
definitions.explanation: To distribute tasks, resources, or roles among people according to a plan or system.

examples.japanese: {役割|やくわり}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる。
{予算|よさん}を{各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}に{割|わ}り{当|あ}てた。
examples.english: The budget was allocated to each department.

examples.japanese: {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}にメンターを{一人|ひとり}ずつ{割|わ}り{当|あ}てることになっている。
examples.english: Each new employee is to be assigned a mentor.

notes:
Often used in business, organizational, and computing contexts. The noun form {割|わ}り{当|あ}て refers to the allocation or assignment itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{役割|やくわり}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる (assign roles)
・{予算|よさん}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる (allocate a budget)
・{担当|たんとう}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる (assign responsibilities)
・{時間|じかん}を{割|わ}り{当|あ}てる (allocate time)
